description: This file defines functions related to socket operations, including emulation of inet_aton for non-Windows systems, and implementation of inet_ntop for Windows systems. It handles platform-specific socket address conversions and includes conditional compilation directives.

methods.name: int inet_aton(const char * cp,struct in_addr * inp)
methods.description: Converts an IPv4 address in dot-decimal notation to binary form; provided here as an emulation for systems lacking this function.

methods.name: const char * inet_ntop(int af,const void * src,char * dst,socklen_t cnt)
methods.description: Converts a network address structure (IPv4 or IPv6) to presentation (string) format; implemented for Windows systems lacking this function.

ctags.name: inet_ntop
ctags.pattern: /^const char *inet_ntop(int af, const void *src, char *dst, socklen_t cnt)$/
